_comment: OpticOdds mapping per the brief: each record holds a nested `odds` object with `home_odds` / `away_odds` as decimal odds objects and `updated_at` as the provider timestamp (drives the 30s freshness rule). This layout covers moneyline and spread; totals need over/under prices (see sharp_provider.opticodds_v3_outcomes.example.json for the per-selection layout). Record-level paths (data, league, home_team, away_team, market, odds.points) and the URL are ASSUMED - verify against your OpticOdds account. Copy to sharp_provider.json and export SHARP_API_KEY.
